_comment: Public allow-list for privacy-scan.mjs. Organisations, library homepages and generic addresses only: never a client, family or person name (those belong in the private deny-list, which is never committed). Every entry says why it is allowed.

githubOwners.why: this repository's organisation account and its GitHub Pages site
GitHub's own actions (actions/checkout, actions/setup-node) used by the workflows
public open-source library: the colour helper bundled with Chart.js, embedded in index.html
public open-source library: JSZip homepage, embedded in index.html
public open-source library: PptxGenJS homepage, embedded in index.html

denylistExemptPaths.why: the legacy product: its embedded reference data names listed companies, funds and fund managers (public vendor data), which share first names and surnames with the private deny-list. Client holdings are never embedded (they are uploaded at run time), and every code change reaches index.html through a patch script in tools/patches/, which the deny-list does scan. The generic rules still apply to index.html.
